legacy.claim: A tracer prediction is uninterpretable until the substrate model specifies all velocity-dependent couplings
legacy.evidence: § The gravitomagnetic gap — electromagnetism supplies a warning, not a proof that an unknown substrate has the same cancellation. [Moving-source gravity bounds](../../studies/moving-source-gravity-bounds.md) now supplies the measured frame-dragging target, but not the model's missing tracer coupling, so this methodological claim remains conjecture. The minimal Branch C equation has no velocity-dependent force at all; that is a debt of any completion, not of the breaking parameters, and is moot with the branch closed
